definitions: made or became flat or flatter
knocked or threw (something or someone) down
made (a musical note) a semitone lower
made (a person or their voice) sound dull or lifeless
examples: The car was completely flattened in the accident.
He flattened his opponent with a single punch.
The bulldozers flattened the old building.
The singer flattened the high note.
The bad news flattened her spirits.
